info.title: TsCommentify.Cli
info.description: A CLI tool that automatically generates JSDoc comments for TypeScript functions, methods, getters, setters, classes, interfaces (including their property and method signatures), enums (including their members), and type alias declarations. Uses a real TypeScript-compiler AST (via a bundled Node sidecar) when Node is available, falling back to an in-process parser otherwise. Supports configurable ignore patterns for test files, and optional flags to stamp @deprecated/@obsolete/@internal/@publicApi tags onto top-level declarations.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: TsCommentify - Add missing comments to TypeScript functions

options.name: --deprecated
options.description: Add an @deprecated tag to generated top-level declaration comments.

options.name: --obsolete
options.description: Add an @obsolete tag to generated top-level declaration comments.

options.name: --internal
options.description: Add an @internal tag to generated top-level declaration comments.

options.name: --public-api
options.description: Add an @publicApi tag to generated top-level declaration comments.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to a TypeScript file or directory containing TypeScript files
